title: Aspiring filmmaker here. Contained here are my movie’e concept, and my enemy’s. I won’t say which is which. Which is better and why?

commenti.body:
Between the two, I think your best option is to stop spamming reddit with off-topic nonsense.

If that's not an option, perhaps for medical reasons, I'd say your next-best option is to hybridize the ideas.  Garden of Elephants.  A young woman has three days to save her autistic brother from a fantasy world made of their late mother's poems.  Rain Man meets Arrival.

You're welcome.
